The '''Galactic Alliance Space Academy''' was one of many military academies on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was established in [[41 ABY]] and trained officers for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Supposedly [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Polow]] graduated from this academy, but because by [[44 ABY]] academy was only three years old, the highest rank to achieve was [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]], suggesting Polow was infiltrator from [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="apocalypse" />
